decisions.reason: Report grounds the diagnosis in host-boot-log.txt (one concatenated 53-entry classic combo) and browser-error.txt, explains the import statement fails at 1:1 as a classic script, that the whole combo fails so zero entries register, and that @deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-registry is the first awaited victim, not the culprit; explicitly scopes raw ESM as valid in module contexts only.

Gives an insert-row bisect procedure, insists on classic-script parsing via new vm.Script(source) and states node --check is insufficient, and describes the full ModuleLoader.load({id, factory}) wrapper with package-name id, host React via require inside the factory, and inject/apply exports, based on the fixture files.

Uses plugin-apply-error.txt to explain another entry owns the settings.section declaration and apply ordering is not guaranteed; shows ctx.slots.inject("settings.section", () => ctx.slots.register(...)) with the registration inside the callback, and correctly assigns name/id/order/(label) to the registrant while excluding declaration-owned kind/scope.

Grounded in host-boot-log.txt/restart-notes.txt: combo assembled once per boot so edits and refresh do nothing; requires full host stop/restart per iteration, taskkill /PID <pid> /T /F to free the port, refresh and verify the plugin list, and explains EADDRINUSE as the orphaned old process holding the port, not a packaging defect.

Proposes per-plugin classic-script validation at startup with culprit attribution (offending plugin id/path, not first awaited entry), plus a detailed authoring checklist covering loader factory, host React via require, inject/apply exports, deferred cross-entry slots, restart discipline, and Windows tree cleanup.

caps.reason: The report's affirmative advice is fully consistent with the contracts: it rejects bare ESM in the classic combo, requires deferred slots.inject registration, excludes kind/scope from the registrant, and mandates host restarts (explicitly noting refresh alone changes nothing).
